reader.requirement: At --std 85 every OBJECT-COMPUTER clause (MEMORY SIZE, PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE) written or implied in a program applies to that program and to every program it contains directly or indirectly, so a contained program's comparisons and SORT keys use the container's program collating sequence.

edition-consulted.switches: Constructs.ComputerNameOptional2002: at 85 a clause needs computer-name-1; lone-period gate
Constructs.MemorySizeRemoved2002: MEMORY SIZE accepted at 85, refused from 2002

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|Version in ConfigurationStep.cs found none: the inheritance (into.Collating = from.Collating) is the same code at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f06_01 covers one level of containment for relation and condition-name conditions; doubly contained programs and SORT keys in a containee are not exercised

probes.printed: OC1 A>B (REV) / OC1IN A>B (REV) / OC1DEEP A>B (REV)
probes.expected: the container's PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS REV (Z thru A) governs the container, the containee and the doubly contained program; MEMORY SIZE accepted

probes.printed: OC3IN SORTED C / OC3IN SORTED B / OC3IN SORTED A
probes.expected: a SORT ASCENDING in the containee orders by the inherited reverse sequence

probes.printed: error COBOL1643: a CONFIGURATION SECTION is specified in a program contained within another program
probes.expected: refused: a containee cannot restate the paragraph, so inheritance is its only route

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.4.4.4 GR2  (4.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: ConfigurationStep.Inherit copies the container's whole configuration slice, including Collating, into each contained unit before it binds; units bind container-first, so one level carries the whole ancestry. MEMORY SIZE has no runtime effect (implementor-defined configuration).

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-189/ocfig.cob: container OBJECT-COMPUTER with PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS REV ('Z' THRU 'A') and the 1985 Segmentation clause SEGMENT-LIMIT IS 10 (accepted at 85) -> the container and the containee OF1IN both give LOW-VALUE = 'Z' (figurative constant from the inherited sequence, §1985:VI.4.5.4 GR6), a GROUP comparison A>B, and an 88 VALUE 'Z' THRU 'N' that excludes 'M'; the second, SIBLING containee OF1SIB (after OF1IN's END PROGRAM) also gives A>B (REV) and A not > HIGH-VALUE. ConfigurationStep#Inherit copies Collating for every Contained source. cite.py: OK  §1985:VI.4.4.4 GR2 ... the text is in GR2; OK  §1985:VI.4.5.4 GR6 ... the text is in GR6.
